# My Agent

My agent sticks to the following guidelines:

All files are written in pure php to be uploaded to a cpanel instance
Php libraries are allowed for things like pdf generation and others but ONLY by manual upload, I dont have access to composer
All things created must be linked to an htaccess so theres no .php in the url bar
It MUST use a mySQL database.
Tabler UI for all pages.
Clean, consistent UI with dark/light mode.
All dependencies must be added manually for pdf generation
There should be no blank pages or probelms with saving ANYTHING, just refresh the page on save and show the alert as a sucess
do NOT add an API
Please follow ALL instructions given and do your best to make it happen in one session. 
If you are told to add something in a list, it MUST be added.
